action_items: Optional cleanup: remove inner <span> wrapper inside <option> in /app/frontend/src/pages/user/FlightsPage.js around the live-pax-count <select> (line 235) to silence pre-existing hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: /live/hold correctly does NOT debit the wallet at hold time (choix 1a) — verified by checking wallet balance before & after; code path lines 433-502 of routes/flights.py never touches db.wallets on hold.

Good: /live/bookings/{id}/pay performs deadline check (lines 516-522), wallet sufficiency check before calling Duffel /air/payments (lines 531-533), then atomic order pay + wallet debit + booking update — order of operations is correct (Duffel paid before local debit; if Duffel fails, no debit).
Good: _norm_offer (line 278) properly exposes hold_available = not requires_instant_payment, payment_required_by, price_guarantee_expires_at on every offer.
Good: /live/hold validates the offer's payment_requirements.requires_instant_payment and returns 409 if not eligible — clear error path.
Good: flight_hold_loop background task (every 10 min) handles expiration (status->expired, notifies user) and ~2h reminder (deadline_notified flag prevents duplicates).

Minor: in /live/pay, if Duffel.create_payment fails AFTER the deadline check passed but BEFORE wallet debit, no debit happens — correct. However if Duffel.get_order at line 540 (post-payment refresh) fails, debit still occurs — could log+catch this to avoid orphan state. Low priority since payment already succeeded.
Minor: currency assumption EUR — pay uses order.total_currency but debits the wallet's EUR balance regardless. Pre-existing concern flagged in iter320.
Minor: pre-existing React hydration warning on FlightsPage live-pax-count <select> (span inside option) — not introduced by this iteration.
